title: Chapter 1476
text:
In the Star Alliance, in the Margas Star System.

A long and narrow spatial rift traversed the starry sky like a knife cutting open the stomach of the universe. Endless green tides sprayed out from within.

Countless World Tree battleships flew out of the wormhole, forming an army. They turned into dense streams of light and scattered in all directions, attacking the planets on the star map.

The World Tree fleet traveled extremely quickly. Not long after, a bustling planet appeared in front of them. The defense forces of this planet had already risen into the sky and were distributed in outer space, ready to defend against the invasion.

Buzz!

At this moment, a ray of light flashed in the distance. A huge fleet of starships covered in starlight rapidly approached. The outer armor of the spaceships was engraved with the mark of the Star Alliance. This was the rapid support team that the military had sent out urgently. They happened to be stationed in the nearby military fortress and were in charge of maintaining the security in the area.

In the flagship of the Star Alliance's rapid support team, the middle-aged commander with a strong temperament gripped the edge of the table tightly with both hands. He gritted his teeth and looked out of the window at the enemy that was countless times more numerous than him.

His heart was filled with despair as he said in a hoarse voice, "Detachment 17 and 18, land and immediately organize the people to board the ships and escape. As for the rest … attack! Stall for time! "

As soon as the order was given, the rapid support team did not stop and immediately launched an attack on the incoming World Tree.

Facing an opponent that they could not match, the Star Alliance fleet still counterattacked. This scene was very tragic. It was like a lone army with no help, enduring the encirclement of countless enemies.

However, even though they were solemn and stirring, the difference in strength would not be shortened because of this. Their fearlessness could not stop the spread of the rolling Green Tide. The world-ending Green Tide did not stop and easily drowned the armed fleet.

The counterattack of the Star Alliance fleet only caused a small splash before disappearing into the endless Green Tide.

Roots tore through the sky and stabbed into this bustling city planet. They were like straws, devouring the matter and energy inside and turning them into their own nourishment.

In the flagship of this World Tree fleet, the Heart Tree King looked down at the planet. His eyes lit up, and his vast psychic power covered the entire planet. He hypnotized all the living beings to give up on escaping and take the initiative to enter the roots, becoming a member of the World Tree.

Seeing the last few Star Alliance battleships explode into pieces under the focus fire of the World Tree fleet, the Heart Tree King shook his head.

"It's just a futile struggle …"

He turned his head to look at the countless soldiers in the cabin and saw that every one of them had a fanatical look on their faces. War was what they were best at.

Sensing the gaze of the Heart Tree King, everyone raised their arms and shouted.

"For the mother tree! For the Father! "

After Black Star subdued the World Tree, he became the 'Father God' in the hearts of all the members of the World Tree, and his will was above the mother tree.

Heart Tree King also silently muttered before retracting his gaze and looking at the starlight in the sky. His gaze seemed to be able to penetrate the endless distance and lock onto the mother planet of the Star Alliance.

…

Star Alliance Capital, Joint Conference Room.

Unlike the joyous atmosphere a few days ago, the room was now filled with a gloomy fog, filled with fear, despair, anxiety, and other negative feelings.

Over the past few days, news of the World Tree's invasion had exploded all over the country. It was as if the entire Star Alliance was in danger overnight, and countless planets had fallen.

All the higher-ups of the Star Alliance present were no longer as high-spirited as they were a few days ago. At this moment, their expressions were haggard, and their clothes were in disarray. They basically did not sleep or rest for the past few days as they argued fiercely again and again.

"Isn't the World Tree Civilization still at war with the three Universal Civilizations? Why did they invade us silently?"

The leader of the Star Alliance frowned. He looked tired, his eyes were bloodshot, and his voice was extremely hoarse.

Savignes trembled slightly and said with a trembling voice, "Could it be that the World Tree Civilization feels that they have already crippled the three Universal Civilizations and wants to fight on two fronts? What should we do? "

The upper echelons of the Star Alliance frowned.

They thought that the three Universal Civilizations were still fighting to the death with the World Tree, but because they had discovered their location, they had taken out a portion of their troops to fight them together. This feeling was like eating someone else's melon happily, but suddenly eating it themselves. They were dumbfounded.

"What else can we do? Since the World Tree is here, we can only resist! "Someone slammed the table to hide the fear in his heart.

As soon as he said that, someone objected loudly.

"What's there to fight for? Even the three Universal Civilizations are no match for the World Tree. They were crippled in a few years. We can't defend our own territories at all. We should quickly migrate the refugees, preserve the fire seed, and abandon our territory! "

"How can we do that? We still have the strength to fight! The World Tree is wreaking havoc in our territory. As long as we send reinforcements, we will definitely be able to repel the World Tree! "another person said with a deep voice.

"Bullsh * t! We don't even have enough troops, why should we help you?! "another person shouted.

This argument immediately ignited the fuse. Everyone's emotions had been like a spring that had been suppressed to the extreme in the past few days. This time, all the dissatisfaction in their hearts erupted, and they were directly divided into two groups. One side wanted to fight, while the other wanted to escape. The argument was extremely intense.

If not for the fact that most of the people present were remote projections, everyone would have rolled up their sleeves and started fighting.

The Star Alliance was formed by more than forty civilizations. They were not united in the first place, and they each had their own interests. Usually, they could gather together, but facing the pressure of a powerful enemy invasion, internal differences immediately erupted.

The opinions of the various member states could not be unified. Some of the upper echelons of the civilizations who did not agree with causing trouble could no longer hold back and started complaining loudly.

"Everyone, calm down! Calm down … We still have other ways. We can't resist the World Tree by ourselves, but since the three Universal Civilizations are in the same situation as us, maybe we can take the initiative to communicate with them and work together to fight the enemy … As for our previous schemes, we can temporarily put them aside. The most important thing is to defeat the World Tree together. They will definitely know the severity of the matter. In the future, we will settle the score with the three Universal Civilizations.

We can only talk about our own future … "The leader of the Star Alliance suggested loudly, trying his best to ease the atmosphere. However, it was useless. Everyone was speechless at his suggestion and turned a deaf ear to it. They continued to argue, and the situation was getting out of control.

In the past, the members of the Star Alliance would not have disrespected him like this, but now that the various civilizations were on the verge of death, no one took him seriously anymore.

Everyone had a huge argument, and many people were furious. They stopped nagging and went offline. They did not plan to listen to the Star Alliance's orders anymore and decided to fly away separately.

Not long after, there was only chicken feathers left in the conference room. The leader of the Star Alliance sat alone in his seat, his heart filled with bitterness.

…

After the argument broke out in the upper echelons, the leaders of the civilizations did not hesitate to issue orders. They did not listen to the Star Alliance's orders at all and packed their resources and population. They hurriedly started to migrate and escape, preparing to escape the Star Alliance's territory and enter the unexplored universe.

Originally, although most of the civilizations were angry and panicked, they had not made up their minds to abandon their homes. However, when they saw someone decisively running away, they immediately became anxious. Everyone else had already run away. If they did not follow, wouldn't they be staying behind to help others? How could this be!

A chain reaction happened very quickly. One Star Alliance member after another did not dare to delay and started to migrate and escape, no longer caring about the Star Alliance's agreement.

When these member states did not listen to the orders, the Star Alliance's mechanism was quickly paralyzed. The huge Star Alliance seemed to have broken up overnight, and the fleets of the various civilizations started to flee and part ways.

In the past, many Star Alliance members would not easily disobey the Star Alliance's orders, or they would be isolated by others. However, they did not care so much now. The World Tree was attacking, and the Star Alliance had different opinions. This allied Universal Civilization was destined to fall apart. Everyone did not plan to wait for death. They only wanted to die instead of dying.

This was Han Xiao's deliberate plan. The weakness of the Star Alliance's organizational structure was too obvious. There were too many interests, and they did not have a leading civilization that had the absolute advantage. They barely managed to gather, and their opinions could not be completely unified.

Usually, the members of the Star Alliance had their misgivings, but once an existential crisis broke out, it would definitely be difficult for them to unite. There was an 80% chance that they would split up. As long as this collective will was broken up, the Star Alliance would be like a small giant being dismembered. Its resistance would plummet by several levels, and it would basically lose most of its fighting spirit.

Back then, the Star Alliance had secretly leaked information to cause internal conflicts in the galactic society. Han Xiao's action was also to give them a taste of their own medicine. He used a method of dividing and dissolving, causing internal conflicts in the other party.

…

The spaceport on the Lore Civilization's mother planet was already packed with people. Anti-gravity transport vehicles transported batches of resources onto the fleet, and countless panic-stricken people lined up to board the ships under the orders of the armed soldiers. No matter how anxious they were, they could only suppress their emotions and obediently listen to the orders.

Not long ago, a group of people wanted to start a riot, but they were directly suppressed by iron and blood and executed on the spot. The blood had not even dried, so no one dared to act rashly.

Not long after, the first fleet was finally full. Without waiting for the rest of the spaceships, they directly took off and fled into the depths of the starry sky.

Savignes was already waiting in the main ship. As the leader of the civilization, he did not dare stay on the mother planet any longer. The escape fleet was divided into several batches. In order to escort him, more than half of the armed forces followed the first escape fleet with the fewest people.

"We've finally set off …"

Savignes heaved a sigh of relief.

He still remembered that in the 'battle report', the two dynasty rulers had been tortured to death by the World Tree. It could be seen that the World Tree Civilization liked to carry out beheadings. He was worried that he would follow in their footsteps and be 'trampled to death'. Therefore, he only wanted to run away as soon as possible and did not dare stay on the mother planet to be a target … As far as he knew, the leaders of the other civilizations had the same idea and had all fled their mother planet.

As the spaceship slowly accelerated, Savignis finally wasn't as worried as before. He muttered to himself, "That's right.

He muttered to himself, "It should be safe for the time being …"

However, before he could finish his sentence, the spaceship's radar suddenly emitted an ear-piercing buzzing sound, pointing straight ahead of the spaceship. An energy reaction appeared out of thin air, blocking their path.

The next moment, a Mechanical Deity expanded in the wind, and its size instantly exceeded the size of the entire fleet. It covered the stars and the sun, and a huge hand suddenly covered them.

Rumble — —

Psionic energy rippled like water, and the entire fleet began to explode like firecrackers. In the blink of an eye, the armed fleet was almost completely wiped out. They could not even cause a ripple, turning into a large expanse of fireworks in the starry sky. It was very beautiful.

"This is Black Star?!"

Savignes was shocked. He hurriedly turned around and shouted,

"Run, run …"

However, before he could finish, the spaceship operators were already sweating profusely.

"This won't do. The fleet's intelligence matrix is completely locked. We can't control it at all. The spaceship is already paralyzed!"

"No …"

Savignes' eyes widened in extreme fear. His pupils reflected the enlarged palm of the Supreme Heavenly Venerate, and the mechanical patterns in his palm became clearer and clearer.

Crack!

Han Xiao grabbed the main ship and sucked it into his body, capturing Savignes and the upper echelons on the ship.

Then, he suddenly raised his hand and hammered. Energy burst out like a gamma-ray burst, spreading out in a large area, instantly 'evaporating' a large group of battleships that were planning to counterattack.

"First one."

Han Xiao turned around and disappeared in a flash, as if he had never been there.

His goal was to capture the leaders of all the civilizations in the Star Alliance and use the advantage of individual strength to capture the leader first.

With his current combat strength, the success rate of the decapitation operation was almost 100% against a civilization at the level of the Star Alliance. No one could stop him.

"His Excellency Savignes has been captured by the enemy!"

Because Han Xiao's decapitation efficiency was too fast, when Savignes and the other upper echelons were captured, the remaining defense forces of the mother planet did not have time to provide support.

The remaining personnel of the ground base stared blankly at the place where Han Xiao had disappeared. Listening to the busy tone in the command channel, they suddenly fell into a state of chaos.

(End of Chapter)
